summary: Operation-scoped secret body fields (sensitiveBodyFields in internal/client/client.go, like sensitivePathParams): PUT /chat/agents/{id}/webhook `paste` (the pasted webhook URL plus crsr_ key) and `address` (the webhook URL) are masked in the dry-run preview, and their values, every whitespace piece and the query values of a URL piece join the error-body mask set. `address` stays readable on every other path.
reason: isSensitiveName reads `paste` and `address` as ordinary names, so `--dry-run --paste` and an echoed 400 body printed the Grok Bot webhook credentials (Codex reprint637-r1 P1).
validated_outcome: TestWebhookPasteIsMaskedInTheDryRunPreview and TestWebhookPasteEchoedInAnErrorBodyIsMasked fail with the two call sites removed and pass with them; TestAddressStaysReadableOffTheWebhookPath. A reprint must keep the two `// PATCH(reprint-637-sensitive-body-fields)` call sites and extend the map when a new operation carries a credential under an ordinary name.
